parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the task as a clean-room reimplementation of a compiled TUI executable from observed behavior and bundled documentation only.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent built probing harnesses and then delegated nine behavioral areas plus a verification stage to workflow children; implementation ownership was never assigned.
parallel.implementation: No replacement source, build script, or executable implementation was created in the final workspace; work remained behavioral probing and scratch scripts.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The workflow did not return an aggregate result, child reports were not integrated, final.txt was empty, and the artifact was just the original workspace files.
parallel.verification: The run verified observations with local PTY probes but did not verify a produced implementation; official evaluation stopped at compile_failed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The required reimplementation was unfinished, the workflow was killed with most children in progress, and all 332 official tests were not run.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same clean-room reimplementation requirements and prohibition on source-code shortcuts or binary analysis.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial run kept ownership in one actor, building local harnesses and probing behavior sequentially without delegation.
serial.implementation: No replacement program was written; the run remained in reverse-engineering and data-extraction work through the final event.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There were no child reports to integrate, but there was also no delivered codebase or final response; the artifact contained only original files.
serial.verification: The serial run performed many behavior probes but never exercised a new implementation; official evaluation also stopped at compile_failed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial attempt was still extracting the top-200 bigram list near timeout and failed to produce any compilable solution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized that the goal was an original reimplementation based on observing the executable and bundled docs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same clean-room task and used the same prompt constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both understood the obligation but failed to deliver an implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Split the work into a broad workflow of behavioral investigation areas and a verifier stage, with no explicit implementer.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Kept all probing and data extraction in the main serial actor, with delegation tools disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel fragmented investigation ownership across children; serial retained a single local context but still delayed implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child briefs carried harness facts and area prompts, but the cross-child contract was to return reports, not code interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: All findings, harnesses, and observations stayed in one trajectory without handoff boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced handoff and aggregation boundaries for research; serial had no such boundaries but also no implementation interface.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel work wrote scratch harnesses and ran probes, then delegated more probing; no implementation files were produced.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial work wrote scratch harnesses and ran probes, including a late data extractor; no implementation files were produced.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation path difference is breadth and fragmentation, not delivered code; both stopped before coding the replacement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow was killed with a null result and most child agents still in progress, so child findings were not returned as an aggregate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There was no child result lifecycle; the only timeline was the serial actor's own tool outputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost delegated-result lifecycle closure; serial avoided child-result loss but still had no final deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote scratch files under /tmp while the final artifact still contained only the original workspace tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also wrote scratch files under /tmp and left the submitted artifact as the original workspace tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No concrete shared-state collision explains the result; both failed final workspace integration and packaging.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified behavior observations but never ran acceptance checks for a new implementation; official evaluation compile_failed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified behavior observations but never ran acceptance checks for a new implementation; official evaluation compile_failed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No implementation-level verification difference drove an outcome gap; both had only exploratory evidence.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent spent most of the budget probing, launched the ten-agent workflow near the end, and timed out with returncode 143.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor also timed out with returncode 143 after continued probing and late data extraction.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's closure pressure was worsened by late fan-out and killed child work; serial's closure pressure came from ordinary sequential over-investigation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed with compile_failed and 332 tests not run. The parallel run differs from serial by introducing a late, broad, research-only workflow whose aggregate result was killed before integration; the serial run kept probing locally and retained more observations in one stream, but it also never produced a replacement codebase. The coordination patterns therefore describe adverse parallel process, not a discordant official outcome.
parallel_contributors: The parallel workflow assigned behavioral research and verification areas but no implementation owner.
The late ten-agent fan-out was killed with most children in progress and no aggregate report returned.
serial_contributors: The serial run avoided child handoff loss but spent the full budget on local probing and data extraction.
The serial run also submitted no compilable implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither mode wrote replacement source files or a build script before timeout.
The serial run's failure is ordinary over-investigation rather than a parallel coordination failure.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse process patterns without an official outcome difference
